name: Doyle
source:
Doyle is a mysterious homeless guy living on the streets below Leah's apartment and one of the love interests alongside Akuji. An intelligent but incredibly lonely individual. Doyle has been watching Leah just as much as she's been watching him. When Doyle finds Leah's purse, he sees it as an opportunity for them to finally meet face to face.

[From [url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/apartment-no9]itch.io[/url]]
